target_protein.species_numbering_offset_warning: CRITICAL: Rat (P20272) and Mouse (P47746) CB1 have 473 amino acids due to a 1-residue insertion in the N-terminus, shifting ALL transmembrane residue numbers by +1 relative to human P21554 (e.g., human F200^3.36 = rat/mouse F201^3.36; human F237^4.46 = rat/mouse F238^4.46; human W356^6.48 = rat/mouse W357^6.48). Always verify species before comparing literature numbers!

topological_segments_uniprot.note: Long flexible loop; TM6 cytoplasmic helical extension begins around D338^6.30 in 3D structures.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F102
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Dips deeply into orthosteric pocket in antagonist-bound inactive CB1 (5TGZ, 5U09) and lifts upward out of the pocket upon agonist binding and activation.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell (5TGZ); Shao et al. 2016 Nature (5U09); Dutta & Shukla 2023 Commun Biol showed N-terminus upward movement is slow and allosterically gates apo CB1 activation.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: M103
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Membrane-proximal N-terminal plug residue; M103-D163(2.50) distance distinguishes inactive (plugged) from agonist-bound/active (lifted) states except in ORG27569-trapped 6KQI.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Used as N-terminus feature reference in Dutta & Shukla 2023 Commun Biol; Fay & Farrens 2013 Biochemistry.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F108
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Aromatic plug contact in antagonist-bound orthosteric cavity and endocannabinoid/inverse-agonist interface.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Contacts AM6538/taranabant in 5TGZ/5U09 and AMG315 in 8GHV.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: N134
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Conserved Class A GPCR N1.50 H-bonding anchor connecting TM1, TM2 (D163^2.50), and TM7 (NPxxY).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Canonical Class A BW anchor.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: H154
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Intracellular TM2 histidine that shifts outward ~4 A alongside F155^2.42 rotation in active Gi-coupled CB1; directly contacts cholesterol in 5XRA and NAM ORG27569 in 6KQI; H154A reduces CP55940 G-protein efficacy.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Krishna Kumar et al. 2023 Nat Commun; Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol; Green et al. 2024 Pharmaceuticals.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F155
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Core-facing in inactive (5TGZ, 5U09), NAM-locked (6KQI), and transducer-free agonist crystal structures (5XRA, 5XR8: chi1 ~ +156/+68 deg, ~9.2-11.3 A to N393^7.49 CA), interacting with TM3, TM6, and NPxxY; flips outward to gauche- (chi1 ~ -57 to -87 deg, ~14.7-16.7 A to N393^7.49 CA) in ALL Gi- and beta-arrestin-coupled structures.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Yang et al. 2022 Nat Chem Biol showed F155W decreases efficacy, F155I increases efficacy, and metadynamics identifies F155^2.42 outward reorientation prior to full TM6 opening as the highest activation barrier; Krishna Kumar et al. 2023 Nat Commun defined the concerted F155^2.42-F237^4.46 activation switch. NOT analyzed in Shukla Group MSM papers.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: S158
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Contacts ORG27569 in 6KQI and crystallographic cholesterol in 5XRA; stabilizes TM2-TM3-TM4 interface.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol; Obi & Natesan 2022 J Med Chem.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: D163
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Conserved Asp2.50 coordinating allosteric Na+ and internal water wire with S167^2.54, S203^3.39, W356^6.48, S390^7.46, and N393^7.49; targeted via a cryptic pocket by G-protein-biased peripheral agonist VIP36 (9B54).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Dutta, Selvam & Shukla 2022 ACS Chem Neurosci; Katritch et al. 2014 TiBS; Rangari et al. 2025 Nature.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: S167
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Polar residue lining the CB1 Na+ / internal water cavity adjacent to D163^2.50.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Dutta, Selvam & Shukla 2022 ACS Chem Neurosci.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: I169
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Crucial hydrophobic anchor for PAMs ZCZ011 (7FEE, 7WV9), GAT229, and biased ago-PAMs (8IKG/8IKH); I169A abolishes ZCZ011/GAT229 PAM activity.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Yang et al. 2022 Nat Chem Biol; Green et al. 2024 Pharmaceuticals; Shen et al. 2024 PNAS.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: S173
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Extracellular TM2 residue whose agonist interactions transmit efficacy signals to intracellular TM2 (F155^2.42-F237^4.46).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Krishna Kumar et al. 2023 Nat Commun; Green et al. 2024 Pharmaceuticals.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: H178
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Polar contact hub for high-efficacy agonists such as AMG315 in MD simulations.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Krishna Kumar et al. 2023 Nat Commun.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F189
key_residues_and_microswitches.motif_or_switch: Non-canonical TM3 extracellular position (Phe instead of Cys)
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Human CB1 has F189^3.25 instead of the canonical Class A C3.25 disulfide partner, giving CB1 unusual N-terminal/ECL2 plasticity; ECL2 instead forms an internal C257-C264 disulfide.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Shao et al. 2016 Nature.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F191
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Forms pi-pi / H-bond interactions with ZCZ011 thiophene ring to stabilize upward TM3 shift; F191A abolishes allosteric agonism.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Yang et al. 2022 Nat Chem Biol; Green et al. 2024 Pharmaceuticals.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F200
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Aromatic partner of W356^6.48 at base of orthosteric pocket. Adopts trans (chi1 ~ +/-175 deg) stacking against W356^6.48 in inactive CB1 (5TGZ, 5U09), NAM-bound 6KQI, and ZCZ011 crystal 7FEE; flips to gauche- (chi1 ~ -64 to -92 deg) toward TM2 in agonist-bound active-like (5XRA, 5XR8, 7V3Z) and all Gi/arrestin-coupled structures.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: McAllister et al. 2004 JBC (mutagenesis); Hua et al. 2017/2025 Nature; Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol; Dutta & Shukla 2023 Commun Biol.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: S203
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Coordinates Na+ ion/water network near D163^2.50; engineered S203K mutation acts as a synthetic Na+ mimic stabilizing inactive CB1 in 6KQI, 7FEE, and 9BA0.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol; Yang et al. 2022 Nat Chem Biol; Kumari et al. 2024 Nat Commun.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: V204
key_residues_and_microswitches.motif_or_switch: Non-canonical PIF-like transmission triad (V204^3.40 - L286^5.50 - L352^6.44)
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: CB1 replaces canonical Class A I3.40 with V204^3.40 (paired with L286^5.50 and L352^6.44), yielding a looser hydrophobic core triad than beta2AR/muOR.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Zhou et al. 2019 eLife.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: T210
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Critical allosteric packing residue above DRY: T210A thermostabilizes inactive states (used in 5TGZ, 5U09, 5XRA, 6KQI, 7FEE, 9BA0), whereas T210I enhances constitutive activity and active-state stability (used in 8WRZ).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Wang et al. 2024 Protein & Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: D213
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Forms intra-DRY salt bridge with R214^3.50 in inactive CB1; protonation/disruption releases R214^3.50 to engage Galpha_i C-terminal alpha5 helix or beta-arrestin finger loop.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Krishna Kumar et al. 2019 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: R214
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Conserved Arg3.50 forming the intracellular ionic lock with D338^6.30 in inactive CB1 (CA-CA 6.75-9.22 A); extends to contact Y294^5.58/Y397^7.53 and Galpha_i C-terminus (C351/D350) upon activation (R214-D338 CA-CA 14.18-17.13 A).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Shao et al. 2016 Nature; Krishna Kumar et al. 2019 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: Y215
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Stabilizes ICL2 conformation for G-protein and beta-arrestin coupling.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Krishna Kumar et al. 2019 Cell; Wang et al. 2024 Protein & Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F237
key_residues_and_microswitches.motif_or_switch: TM2-TM4 F155-F237 activation switch & NAM/cholesterol pocket
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Bulky aromatic unique to CB1 (Leu in CB2, small aliphatic in beta2AR/muOR/M2R). Points inward toward TM2-TM3 in inactive (5TGZ, 5U09), ORG27569-bound (6KQI), ZCZ011 crystal (7FEE), and transducer-free agonist crystal structures (5XRA, 5XR8, 7V3Z: chi1 ~ -72 to -88 deg), where cholesterol (5XRA) or ORG27569 (6KQI) wedges against it; flips to trans (chi1 ~ +154 to -170 deg) rotating outward in ALL Gi- and arrestin-coupled active complexes to avoid steric clash with outward-moving F155^2.42.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Shao et al. 2016 Nature; Wickert et al. 2018 Front Mol Neurosci (rat F238L = human F237L increases basal endocytosis/activity); Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol (6KQI); Krishna Kumar et al. 2023 Nat Commun (8GHV). NOT analyzed in Shukla Group MSM papers.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: C238
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Directly contacts ORG27569 in 6KQI and cholesterol in 5XRA.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol; Obi & Natesan 2022 J Med Chem.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: W241
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Conserved Trp4.50 forming the floor/wall of the extrahelical ORG27569 and cholesterol pocket.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: C257
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Forms 2.03-2.04 A disulfide bridge with C264 within ECL2 (replacing the absent TM3-ECL2 disulfide).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Shao et al. 2016 Nature.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: C264
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Disulfide partner of C257 stabilizing the ECL2 lid over the hydrophobic orthosteric pocket.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Shao et al. 2016 Nature.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F268
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Projects deeply into the orthosteric pocket to contact cannabinoid cores in agonist-bound CB1.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2017/2025 Nature; Krishna Kumar et al. 2019 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: W279
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Forms deep active-state agonist contacts in CB1.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Dutta & Shukla 2023 Commun Biol.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: L286
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: CB1 lacks conserved Class A Pro5.50, carrying Leu286^5.50 instead, yielding a straighter TM5 helix.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: Y294
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Remains oriented inside the helical bundle in both inactive and active CB1 (unlike CB2 where Y5.58 flips from membrane-facing to bundle-facing), but forms a tight 2.9-4.2 A phenolic OH H-bond with Y397^7.53 ONLY in transducer-coupled active states (vs 5.1-5.5 A in 5XRA/5XR8/7V3Z and 10.5-11.8 A in inactive states).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Dutta & Shukla 2023 Commun Biol; Krishna Kumar et al. 2019 Cell; Hua et al. 2020 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: D338
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Forms salt bridge with R214^3.50 in inactive CB1 (R214-D338 CA-CA 6.75 A in 5U09, 7.20 A in 6KQI, 8.69 A in 5TGZ); swings outward upon TM6 opening (14.18-17.13 A).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Shao et al. 2016 Nature; Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Krishna Kumar et al. 2019 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: L352
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Replaces canonical Phe6.44 of Class A PIF motif with Leu352^6.44 below the CWxP hinge.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell; Zhou et al. 2019 eLife.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: C355
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Part of the conserved C355-W356-G357-P358 hinge on TM6.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: W356
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Aromatic toggle partner of F200^3.36. Undergoes upward/TM5-directed translational shift upon agonist activation as F200^3.36 flips toward TM2; remains locked in inactive pose in ORG27569-bound 6KQI despite CP55940 pocket contraction; adopts distinct trans chi1 (-177.4 deg) in FUB-bound CB1-beta-arrestin-1 (8WU1) vs gauche- (-59 to -87 deg) in Gi complexes.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: McAllister et al. 2004 JBC; Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol; Dutta et al. 2022 JBC; Dutta & Shukla 2023 Commun Biol; Liao et al. 2023 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: G357
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Flexible glycine in CWGP motif facilitating TM6 kink/hinge motion.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: P358
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Conserved Pro6.50 kink pivot enabling intracellular TM6 outward displacement.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: S383
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Forms key hydrogen bond with phenolic hydroxyl of classical/non-classical cannabinoids (AM11542, AM841, CP55940, THC).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2017/2025 Nature; Shao et al. 2019 Nat Chem Biol.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: S390
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Coordinates Na+ / internal water network with D163^2.50 and N393^7.49.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Dutta, Selvam & Shukla 2022 ACS Chem Neurosci.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: N393
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Couples the D163^2.50 Na+/water network to intracellular TM7 inward movement; N393D stabilizes inactive state in 7FEE.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Yang et al. 2022 Nat Chem Biol; Katritch et al. 2014 TiBS.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: P394
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Conserved Pro7.50 of NPIIY motif enabling TM7 inward bending upon activation.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: I395
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: First isoleucine of human CB1 NPIIY motif.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: I396
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Second isoleucine of human CB1 NPIIY motif.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Hua et al. 2016 Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: Y397
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Swings inward upon activation (R214-Y397 CA distance drops from 16.4-18.1 A in inactive to 12.1-12.8 A in active) to H-bond with Y294^5.58 (OH-OH 2.9-4.2 A in Gi/arrestin complexes); also serves as central Tyr of the TM7/H8 CRAC motif (V392-Y397-K402).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Krishna Kumar et al. 2019 Cell; Oddi et al. 2011 J Neurochem; Dutta et al. 2022 JBC.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: K402
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: C-terminal basic residue of the CB1 cholesterol-recognition (CRAC) motif (V392-X4-Y397-X4-K402) and direct interface residue for beta-arrestin-1 (K402A reduces arrestin recruitment).
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Oddi et al. 2011 J Neurochem; Wang et al. 2024 Protein & Cell.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: L404
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Hydrophobic anchor of amphipathic Helix 8 parallel to inner membrane leaflet; L404A reduces CP55940 G-protein dissociation efficacy.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Green et al. 2024 Pharmaceuticals.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: F408
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: Aromatic anchor on Helix 8 (putative pregnenolone/allosteric site 8); F408A reduces CP55940 efficacy.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Green et al. 2024 Pharmaceuticals.

key_residues_and_microswitches.label: C415
key_residues_and_microswitches.functional_role: S-palmitoylated cysteine anchoring the end of Helix 8 into the inner membrane leaflet and lipid rafts, regulating G-protein coupling and membrane microdomain partitioning.
key_residues_and_microswitches.literature_notes: Oddi et al. 2017 BBA Mol Cell Biol Lipids; UniProt P21554.

recommended_order_parameters_for_md.name: TM6_outward_opening_CA
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.physical_meaning: Canonical intracellular TM3-TM6 opening; necessary for transducer binding but DOES NOT distinguish uncoupled active-like crystals (5XRA/5XR8/7V3Z) from fully coupled active states.

recommended_order_parameters_for_md.name: F155_F237_TM2_TM4_switch
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.inactive_and_5XRA_state: F155 chi1 trans/gauche+ (+59 to +167 deg, COM-N393 ~9.2-11.3 A inward); F237 chi1 gauche- (~ -85 deg inward)
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.transducer_active_state: F155 chi1 gauche- (-57 to -87 deg, COM-N393 ~14.7-16.7 A outward); F237 chi1 trans (+154 to -170 deg outward)
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.physical_meaning: CB1-specific intracellular aromatic gate coupled to extrahelical cholesterol/ORG27569 pocket; orthogonal to TM6 opening across 5XRA vs 6N4B/8GHV!

recommended_order_parameters_for_md.name: Twin_toggle_switch_F200_W356
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.inactive_state: F200 chi1 trans (~ +/-175 deg); W356 stacked over F200
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.active_Gi_state: F200 chi1 gauche- (~ -64 to -82 deg toward TM2); W356 shifts toward TM5 (chi1 ~ -59 to -87 deg)
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.active_arrestin_8WU1_state: F200 chi1 -92 deg; W356 flips to trans (chi1 = -177.4 deg) under deeper FUB insertion

recommended_order_parameters_for_md.name: NPxxY_tyrosine_lock
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.physical_meaning: Direct/water-mediated H-bond locking TM5 and TM7 inward around the collapsed Na+ pocket; incomplete in 5XRA/5XR8/7V3Z despite outward TM6.

recommended_order_parameters_for_md.name: Na_pocket_hydration_and_collapse
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.physical_meaning: Collapse of the allosteric Na+ cavity and reorganization of the internal water wire connecting D163^2.50, W356^6.48, and N393^7.49/Y397^7.53.

recommended_order_parameters_for_md.name: N_terminal_V_loop_plug
recommended_order_parameters_for_md.physical_meaning: Extracellular N-terminal V-loop insertion into vs lifting out of the orthosteric pocket.
